name: paper-birds
description: Paper Birds — a code-generated handmade paper toy theatre short film (Remotion + three.js)

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts PaperBirds out/video-16x9.mp4 --muted && node scripts/mux-audio.mjs out/video-16x9.mp4 out/paper-birds-16x9.mp4
